text:
Kai: Heads-up — saw a spike of `413 Request Entity Too Large` on /v1/embeddings when a customer sent mixed-dimension arrays. Happened right after the canary rollout for batch-size heuristics.

Lisa: ugh. do we have a repro? prod logs/showing payload sizes? :eyes: 

Kai: minimal repro in staging: send two vectors, dims 1536 and 768 together. total payload ~1.2MB and splitter decided not to split because `batch_max_tokens` heuristic used token estimate, not raw bytes. log excerpt:

```
[ingest] request_id=rid_1983 payload_bytes=1234567 dims=[1536,768] selector=keep_as_batch reason="tokens_est<=batch_tokens"
[splitter] decision=NO_SPLIT predicted_latency=24ms cache_hit=false
```

Mike: hmm our splitter uses token estimates derived from `avg_tokens_per_element` which is ok for text but sucks for numeric vectors. We never considered bytes-per-dim variance. 

Ashley: Related: console dashboard shows per-route throughput and P50 latency, but no direct metric for `payload_bytes` or `embeddings_dim_histogram`. We should add a gauge and anomaly alerts.

Kai: +1 on the histogram. Current telemetry only emits `batch.size` and `batch.count` which hides skew when a single request is huge.

Lisa: temporary mitigation: reject mixed-dims with 400 and ask client to split. But that's a breaking change for some embedded clients. We could instead enforce a hard `payload_bytes` limit at the router layer and return 413 with guidance.

Mike: can we make splitter aware of `bytes_per_dim`? heuristic: compute bytes = dims * float32_size (4) * count + overhead. If bytes > split_threshold -> force split. That will catch mixed dims reliably.

Kai: prototype patch attached in PR #4021:

```
// in batch_selector
estimated_bytes = elements.map(e => e.dim * 4).sum() + overhead
if (estimated_bytes > cfg.max_payload_bytes) forceSplit()
```

Ashley: PR looks fine. Need UI/Console changes: 
- show `embeddings.payload_bytes` as a node on the per-route breakdown
- chart `dim_distribution` (histogram) with a 95th percentile annotation
- add an alert: `sum(embeddings.payload_bytes) by route` rate> threshold OR `p99(payload_bytes)` > X -> warn

Lisa: plus rollout UX: when we roll the bytes-splitting heuristic, console should show canary VS control split hit-rate and error delta so we can quickly rollback if false positives spike.

Mike: agree. Also need e2e telemetry: tag batches with `split_reason: bytes_threshold` so we can slice in dashboards and detect if we over-split small vectors.

ops-bot: Alert: HIGH_ERROR_RATE on /v1/embeddings for acct=acme-corp at 2029-11-20T09:12:30Z - rate 11/min (baseline 0.5/min)

Ashley: ops-bot aligns with Kai's timestamp. let's prioritize: 1) router bytes check, 2) telemetry emits payload_bytes & split_reason, 3) console widgets + alert, 4) canary rollout with canary metrics visible.

Lisa: i'll open a tracking ticket for the console widgets (ENG-embed-715). Mike/Kai can own the runtime change, Ashley will do dashboard+alerts.

Mike: starting work on runtime change, will add feature flag `embed.bytes_split_v1`. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Kai: I'll add the synthetic test and put a failing integration case in staging so the canary will flag it early.

Ashley: UX note — when we show 413 guidance in the API response, let's include an example snippet:

```
HTTP 413
{ "error": "payload too large - split arrays by dimension or send as multiple requests", 
  "hint": "split into arrays of uniform dim or reduce payload_bytes under 1MB"
}
```

Lisa: do we have a preferred default threshold? current observed fail at 1.2MB. maybe set default to 1MB and make config per-tenant.

Mike: default 1MB sounds safe. make it configurable on Dedicated/Private. Hosted can have per-account override via quotas.

Ashley: Also update docs and quickstart with a note about mixed-dim arrays and suggested client helpers.

Kai: thanks team. will follow up with PR link and staging CI results. :thumbsup:
